title: Add Author Section to README.md
description: Update the project's README.md file to include an 'Author' section with attribution to the project creator.
details: Open the README.md file in the root directory. Add a new section titled '## Author' or '## Credits' near the end of the file. Include the author's name, 'RafiulM', and link it to their GitHub profile (e.g., [RafiulM](https://github.com/RafiulM)). Ensure the formatting matches the rest of the document and does not disrupt existing content.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the README.md file in a markdown previewer or on the repository's hosting platform to confirm the new section appears correctly formatted and the link works.
